apps.localizedDescription:
Coming soon to iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV.

Your Windows and Mac games. Without the streaming. Vapor is bringing compatible Windows and Mac games to your device with local gameplay, direct downloads, and customizable controls.

Browse your Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG libraries, download games you own, and keep everything together in one place. Play with touch controls or a compatible controller, and adjust graphics and performance settings for each game.

Vapor is in development, and downloads are not available yet. Game compatibility and performance will vary by title and device. Games are not included.

Vapor beta is coming soon to iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV.

Get an early look at Windows and Mac games running locally on your device. Explore upcoming Vapor features, customizable controls, per-game settings, and compatibility improvements before the public release.

Bring your Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG libraries together and discover a new way to play the games you own.

The beta is in development, and downloads are not available yet. Features, game compatibility, and performance can change between builds. Games are not included.
